title: Allowances PRD
subject: Visigoth Bank, an invented retail bank

records.title: Counted-but-not-blocked charges can read as a broken promise
records.quote: These are counted against the allowance but not blocked.
records.detail: A parent who sets a $50 allowance will read it as a cap. Transit taps and in-flight purchases can take the card user past it. If the disclosure in 7.3 is weak, this is a conduct risk and a complaints driver.
records.suggestion: Make the 7.3 disclosure a launch gate with Compliance sign-off, and show counted charges in the app the same day.

records.title: No control proves a limit decline stays out of fraud scoring
records.quote: A limit decline must never raise the fraud score or open a fraud case.
records.detail: The requirement is right but has no evidence attached. Fraud models retrain on decline history, so a new decline reason leaks in unless it is excluded on purpose.
records.suggestion: Add an acceptance test and a named owner in Fraud Strategy.

records.title: Consent for under 18s does not say whose consent
records.quote: An allowance for a card user under 18 needs recorded consent.
records.detail: Consent from the cardholder and consent from the minor are different records with different retention rules.
records.question: Who gives consent for a card user under 18: the cardholder, or both?
records.suggestion: Name the consenting party and where the record is kept.

records.title: 90 days of decline history has no stated retention basis
records.quote: 90 days of limit declines in the existing account view
records.detail: Fine in practice, but the retention schedule should list it.

records.title: Ten seconds is too slow at a till
records.quote: the card user gets a message within 10 seconds
records.detail: In the spring interviews, five of eight teenagers said they would walk away before checking their phone. The explanation has to arrive while they are still standing there.
records.suggestion: Target 3 seconds, and say what to do next: ask for a top-up.

records.title: Telling a teenager how far over they were may embarrass more than help
records.quote: says how far over the purchase was
records.detail: The useful number is what is left, not the shortfall. Showing the shortfall on a lock screen is also visible to friends.
records.suggestion: Show what is left and a top-up button. Keep the shortfall inside the app.

records.title: Two alerts for nearly the same moment
records.quote: the card user is alerted when the remaining allowance drops below a threshold
records.detail: The low-balance alert and the over-allowance alert can arrive within minutes of each other.
records.suggestion: Drop 5.4 from launch, or merge them.

records.title: The FAQ contradicts section 3.3
records.quote: It applies from the next cycle.
records.detail: Section 3.3 says a changed amount applies right away.
records.answer: 3.3 is right. The FAQ is out of date.
